title: General-ring integral stalk detector

from.place: Tag 09Z6 (3), proof Steps 1--5, fixed point x

statement: Let Λ be a Noetherian commutative ring, X a Noetherian scheme, F a constructible Λ-module sheaf, and x a point of X. There are an integral morphism ν : Y → X, a finitely generated Λ-module M, and a map φ : F → ν_* constantSheaf(M) such that φ is injective on every geometric stalk above x.

source.place: Tag 09Z6 (3), proof Steps 1--5, fixed point x

proof.text: On Spec of the residue field, the stratum containing its unique point has full image. Immersion independence makes the sheaf finite locally constant. Choose one member of a trivializing etale cover and pass to its residue field, a finite separable extension. Pull back the constant trivialization; its value is finitely generated because its geometric stalk is finitely generated.

Normalize the reduced closure of x in that finite extension. Transport the normal constant generic-point unit along the source-field isomorphism. The inverse-image composition isomorphisms identify the generic restriction of the pullback of F with that of the constant sheaf.

Use the generic-point adjunction and the inverse of the constant-sheaf unit to construct the map on the normalization, then adjoint it down to X. Every algebraically closed geometric point over x lifts through the finite field extension. The two adjunction triangle identities and naturality of the inverse-image stalk comparison show that the map has an invertible composite on each such stalk, hence is injective.

mathlib_searches.query: Constructible module sheaf over a Noetherian ring admits a stalkwise injective map to pushforward of a constant sheaf along a finite morphism

lean.statement:
theorem exists_integral_lowerStar_stalk_injective_noetherian
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [IsNoetherianRing Λ]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    [IsConstructibleSheaf F] (x : X) :
    ∃ (Y : Scheme.{u}) (ν : Y ⟶ X), IsIntegralHom ν ∧
      ∃ (M : ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), Module.Finite Λ M ∧
        ∃ (φ : F ⟶ (lowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) ν).obj
          ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).obj M)),
          ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
            (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
            ((Scheme.SpecToEquivOfField Ω X) s).1 = x →
              Function.Injective
                (((Scheme.pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber
                  (A := ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)).map φ)
